If heads, search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name. Shuffle your deck afterward. This power can be used even if Unown [Y] is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
[Psychic] Hidden Power 10
You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
